meta.title: Voyager Open Blocks, local development
meta.description: Used by npm run dev and npm run screenshots, which mount this checkout as the plugin. Activates it, then runs playground/seed.php: demo Site Data and one page per item under /voyager-open/, the same seeding blueprint.json does. Last, it installs the test fixture tests/fixtures/purge-recorder.php as an mu-plugin, for npm run e2e. Not for playground.wordpress.net, because it installs nothing.
meta.author: voyager-marketing

steps.code: <?php require_once '/wordpress/wp-load.php'; $from = WP_PLUGIN_DIR . '/voyager-open-blocks/tests/fixtures/purge-recorder.php'; if ( is_file( $from ) ) { wp_mkdir_p( WPMU_PLUGIN_DIR ); copy( $from, WPMU_PLUGIN_DIR . '/voyager-open-blocks-purge-recorder.php' ); }
